correctness.rationale: PASS. Headline lower bound C*>=8 via i.i.d. shifted-exponential witness verified line-by-line and by replay. For Y~Exp(1), E[Y^m]=m! is standard; E[(Y-1)^4]=24-24+12-4+1=9, E[X1]=1-1=0, E[X1^2]=2-2+1=1, so Var(X1)=1 and Var(X1^2)=9-1=8 — all exact integer arithmetic. Replay of inputs/artifacts/verify_sharpness.py PASS confirms E4=9, mean 0, var 1, Var(X1^2)=8 plus Gaussian 2 and cube 4/5 sanity checks. Isotropy follows from i.i.d. mean-0 var-1 (E X=0, Cov=Id). Log-concavity holds: 1D density f(x)=e^{-(x+1)}1_{x>=-1} has convex support [-1,inf) and affine log-density, hence log-concave; product on convex [-1,inf)^n with linear log-density is log-concave. Variance sums by independence: Var(|X|^2)=sum Var(Xi^2)=8n exactly for every n>=1. No boundary error; density is absolutely continuous w.r.t. Lebesgue as required. The DRAFT honestly disclaims the target/fallback upper bounds and 1D maximality, so no overclaim infects the headline.
